summary_1line: Stories trace Gunahina’s redemption through rebirths leading to Kubera, tales of Ravana and Lanka, Manmatha’s curse, Sandhya’s transformation, and Sati’s birth and devotion to Shiva.

image_candidates.scene_text: Starving Gunahina inside the dark temple tears his cloth to keep the dying lamp burning before the Shiva Linga.
Parvati’s angry gaze strikes Vaisravana, shattering his eye as Shiva stands beside her in radiant calm.
Young Sati sits before her painted image of Shiva, offering flowers and incense while gazing at it with longing.
